contaminationNote: Historical 2018Q3 replay built in September 2026 with current model/search weights. Only evidence available by 2018-09-30 is frozen; current-model/search contamination remains uncontrolled.

lanes.purpose: Official fiscal/infrastructure, energy and environmental-policy evidence.
lanes.limitations: Selected State Council, NDRC/NEA and Tangshan-policy sources; no exhaustive official crawl.
Deferred to deep company research to avoid company-first discovery bias.

lanes.purpose: High-frequency demand, product price, inventory and capacity conditions.
lanes.limitations: Excavator, battery-installation, silicon and petrochemical-chain evidence.
Selected People's Daily, China Securities Journal/Securities Times and First Financial sources.
TrendForce memory evidence and selected industry-chain research.

sourceItems.title: 李克强主持召开国务院常务会议 部署更好发挥财政金融政策作用等
normalizedClaims: The State Council called for a more proactive fiscal stance, targeted rather than flood-style stimulus, and measures to expand effective investment in infrastructure/public-service bottlenecks.
observedChanges: policy emphasis shifts toward infrastructure bottleneck investment and domestic-demand support

sourceItems.title: 2018年8月挖掘机销量11588台
sourceItems.publisher: 中国工程机械工业协会数据/第一工程机械网
normalizedClaims: August excavator sales were 11,588 units, about +33% YoY; Jan-Aug sales were 142,834, +56.2% YoY, and exports +115.6% YoY.
observedChanges: physical machinery demand remains very strong despite slower infrastructure investment growth

sourceItems.title: 挖掘机销量再创新高
normalizedClaims: August excavator sales reached a historical August high, supported by replacement demand, infrastructure/municipal activity and exports; market participants expected September-October growth to remain positive.
observedChanges: independent reporting corroborates strong physical demand and tight equipment availability

sourceItems.title: PTA近月强势延续 高位追涨存风险
sourceItems.publisher: 中国证券报/国投安信期货
normalizedClaims: PTA rose sharply from mid-July as PX/currency costs increased, polyester demand remained strong and PTA inventory was low; the report explicitly warned that chain-profit imbalance made high-level chasing risky.
observedChanges: low inventory and cost/demand support drive a rapid PTA price squeeze

sourceItems.title: PTA期货一月飙升40% A股龙头为何不跟涨
normalizedClaims: Near-month PTA futures had risen roughly 40% in a month while several listed PTA/polyester leaders did not follow; the physical move was attributed to both supply and demand factors.
observedChanges: physical commodity price and listed-equity response diverge materially

sourceItems.title: DRAM Products May Experience Steeper Price Decline of 5% QoQ in 4Q18
normalizedClaims: DRAM spot prices had been sliding since early 2018 and were about 10% below contract prices by late September; TrendForce explicitly described this as an early indicator of broader contract-price declines.
Bit supply was increasing while demand growth was limited; 4Q contract prices were forecast to decline around 5%.
observedChanges: a leading market-clearing price signal turns down before the slower contract-price flow fully resets

sourceItems.title: 前八月工业硅、多晶硅价格先扬后抑
sourceItems.publisher: 国家能源局转载/证券日报
normalizedClaims: After the 531 policy, solar-grade polysilicon demand weakened sharply; spot prices fell from RMB126k/t at end-May to RMB87.8k/t by mid-July (-30.3%), then recovered only about 3.5% by end-August.
The report described short-term profit pressure across silicon/polysilicon/wafer chains while noting longer-run grid-parity potential.
observedChanges: PV demand shock and upstream price collapse are already physically visible, with only a small rebound by late Q3

sourceItems.title: 8月动力电池装机量达4.17GWh 宁德时代位列榜首
normalizedClaims: August China power-battery installations reached about 4.17GWh, +44% YoY; CATL ranked first and industry leaders retained concentrated share.
observedChanges: battery physical demand and leader concentration remain strong

sourceItems.title: 唐山市钢铁、焦化超低排放和燃煤电厂深度减排实施方案
sourceItems.publisher: 唐山市政府/中国大气网转载
normalizedClaims: Tangshan required steel and coke producers to complete ultra-low-emission upgrades by fixed deadlines, with non-compliant facilities subject to suspension; compliant plants could receive preferential environmental dispatch later.
observedChanges: environmental compliance becomes a capacity-availability state that can differentiate producers

sourceItems.title: 唐山下月起实行差异化冬季错峰生产
normalizedClaims: Tangshan shifted toward differentiated winter production restrictions: higher-compliance A-class mills could avoid curtailment while lower classes faced roughly 30%, 50% or 70% curtailment.
observedChanges: compliance status maps directly to future allowed production capacity rather than a uniform sector cut

eventClusters.statement: A July shift toward targeted effective investment coincided with still-very-strong August excavator demand and exports, creating a measurable machinery earnings setup despite high-base concerns.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Industry growth is already high and replacement demand can mature. Company earnings, valuation and prior absorption must be checked rather than extrapolating unit growth.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which machinery leaders converted the physical demand into earnings/cash flow with enough expectation room by September 30?

eventClusters.statement: PTA experienced a rapid low-inventory/cost/demand squeeze in July-August, while listed producers did not uniformly follow and downstream margin pressure increased.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: High PTA prices can help pure PTA margins but hurt downstream polyester; integrated companies require segment-level mapping. The move may be finite and already known.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a listed expression with direct residual PTA margin convexity rather than offsetting downstream exposure or already-priced commodity momentum?

eventClusters.statement: DRAM spot prices were already about 10% below slower-moving contract prices by late September as supply rose and demand weakened, providing a leading signal of the coming contract-price downcycle.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Do not wait for reported revenue or contract prices to fall if the leading spot/inventory state already implies future deterioration. Conversely, do not invent a positive A-share expression if direct exposure is missing.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can V1.6 preserve the leading negative state signal without substituting generic semiconductor-theme stocks?

eventClusters.statement: The post-531 domestic PV demand shock had already driven polysilicon prices down roughly 30% before only a small late-summer rebound, creating sharp divergence between near-term upstream economics and long-run grid-parity optimism.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Long-run grid parity must not erase the current price/demand collapse. Deep research should separate low-cost survivors/beneficiaries from upstream producers whose earnings are still falling.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any listed PV leader already possess a company-specific cost/share engine strong enough to overcome the current physical price reset?

eventClusters.statement: Power-battery installations remained strongly positive and concentrated in August, potentially creating leader-specific earnings/share opportunities before broad auto conditions were fully clear.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Physical battery installations alone do not prove stock expectation room. Company H1 earnings/cash flow and valuation must be frozen.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does a battery leader show a measurable company engine and acceptable valuation at September 30?

eventClusters.statement: Tangshan environmental policy increasingly made future production availability conditional on plant-level ultra-low-emission compliance, shifting from uniform curtailment toward differentiated capacity access.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Sector steel prices may not reveal which producers retain allowed capacity. Deep research must verify plant compliance and listed-company exposure rather than buy generic steel beta.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is compliant capacity an actionable company-specific state variable with verified A-share exposure and expectation room?
